notes: All that is asked for is the gathering space of a round-based story game, and the lobby is the thing Party & Casual is built around, so it leads with Adventure named second for the story rounds it feeds. The lobby is the entire map here, so space-bounded takes it in this genre's own wording — the gathering space is the play space — and there is no isolated stage to build, which keeps it off space-staged's P4; teleporter-link stays because the markers into the round are the one piece of the round the lobby owns, and this genre's row carries no pipeline cost where Entertainment's portal version would have. No preset survived: Minigame is the closest mode but I would have had to swap its shape and drop both its round-side options, so this is built from scratch instead. Without a user I took the author's bright, cartoony, small plaza with several simple buildings, put those buildings on settlement-density, and left out a leaderboard wall since nobody asked for one.
